headlines.title: America’s Rare Earth Reckoning Is Less Than 60 Days Away
headlines.summary: Trump’s $12 billion rare earth plan faces a critical test as a January 1 Pentagon deadline collides with America’s dependence on Chinese processing.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Takes 38% Of Thacker Pass In U.S. Lithium Push
headlines.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) holds a 38% ownership stake in the Thacker Pass lithium project in Nevada. The Thacker Pass project is supported by a large loan from the U.S. Department of Energy as part of a domestic supply push. GM views Thacker Pass as a key source of lithium for future electric vehicle batteries under its long term electrification plans. GM's 38% stake in Thacker Pass highlights only one side of the story around its EV battery supply chain plans.

headlines.title: Citi Loads Up On Tesla, Lucid And Rivian In Q3 While Slashing XPeng, General Motors
headlines.summary: Citi increased its Tesla common-stock holding 10.1% to 8.69 million shares, worth roughly $3.09 billion at the quarter-end.

headlines.title: General Motors Gains 12% in a Week to a 52-Week High: Is There Room to Run?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors stock rose 12% in a week to a 52-week high, as Ford’s raised outlook and the midterm results sent investors toward Detroit and away from Tesla. Consensus estimates have GM’s normalized EPS rising to $16.

headlines.title: Ford and GM see savings drivers may pay for later
headlines.summary: Detroit gets a break on vehicle costs. The gas pump tells a different story.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
